driver_choices.quartiles: nearest rank over the size's screened worlds
driver_choices.replicate_sign_pairing: replicate i of one arm with replicate i mod R of the other
driver_choices.screen_spread_merge: an EXP-0050 stratum with no df (e.g. no stochastic argmax arm) takes its size's pool
driver_choices.split_rounding: held-out round_half_up(0.2 n), validation round_half_up(0.4 n) - held-out
driver_choices.two_stochastic_argmax_arms: SE_w replicate term = sum of sigma_rep^2 / R over the stochastic argmax arms

pruning.rule_text: Drop a member that is never the per-episode argmax on any development episode at any measured economy size. Every member attaining an episode's max value counts as its argmax (ties never prune a co-winner). The evidence must cover every member on every episode.
